implementationWarning: This is an integration SPECIFICATION. It does not run by itself. The developer MUST verify this biome actually exists and is implemented in the Soul Bound Dimension mod (find its real registry name) before wiring these effects. Do not add or create the biome from this file.
biomeRegistryNameNote: Unknown to the asset author. Fill in after verifying in the mod's worldgen data (data/<modid>/worldgen/biome/*.json).
intensityNote: 0..1 multiplier applied to all spawn rates. Blend smoothly using sky angle; day = skyLight-adjusted sun, night = moon phase. Underground biomes ignore day/night.

x2_golden_glass_sandstorm.meaning: Average spawns/second inside the active player area at preset High and intensity 1.0, before weather/mob modifiers. Use random jitter (+/-30%).

x2_singing_crystal_resonance.meaning: Average spawns/second inside the active player area at preset High and intensity 1.0, before weather/mob modifiers. Use random jitter (+/-30%).

fog.implementation: Requires Java: Forge ViewportEvent.ComputeFogColor + ViewportEvent.RenderFog, or biome JSON effects.fog_color / water_fog_color where the biome file allows. No fullscreen overlay textures are used.

x2_golden_glass_sandstorm.note: Moves with wind direction at ~0.12 b/tick; keep ribbons near ground level (0.5-4 b). Strong reduction in combat.

x2_singing_crystal_resonance.note: One-shot; spawn at glass block positions on a random timer.

x2_golden_glass_sandstorm.location: open desert air close to the ground, drifting with wind direction; spawn upwind 10-24 b

x2_singing_crystal_resonance.location: at glass blocks/formations within 20 b; random 3-9 s interval per formation

weatherVariations.sandstorm: optional custom weather: sandstorm ribbons x3 (cap 8 alive), fog density +25%, resonance x0.8

ambientLighting.note: Warm golden tint; stronger at dusk.
ambientLighting.emissiveParticles: Particles flagged fullbright in the effect manifest return LightTexture.FULL_BRIGHT (15728880) from getLightColor; others use world light.
